On this page
GR32_Transforms>InvertProcedure

Invert

Inverts a 3x3 floating-point matrix in place.

Declaration ​

pascal
procedure Invert(var M: TFloatMatrix);

Parameters ​

ParameterTypeDescription
MTFloatMatrixMatrix to invert in place.

Description ​

Invert calculates the inverse matrix M−1 in place using the classical adjoint method divided by the matrix determinant (adj(M)/det(M)). If |det(M)|<10−5 (near-singular matrix), M is reset to IdentityMatrix.
